description_full: Alliance Entertainment Holding Corporation distributes and retails physical entertainment and collectible products for the entertainment industry internationally. It offers vinyl records, video games, digital video discs, Blu-ray, toys, compact discs, electronics, collectibles, and other entertainment and consumer products, as well as toys, figures, limited-edition collectibles, and licensed memorabilia. The company also provides third party logistics products and services. It distributes its physical media, entertainment products, hardware, and accessories through a multichannel strategy. The company exports its products. Alliance Entertainment Holding Corporation was founded in 1990 and is based in Plantation, Florida.

financial_summary: Alliance Entertainment Holding  is a micro-cap communication services business with a $252M market cap on $3M of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at -87% over the past three years, and a shrinking top line is the hardest headwind any business can overcome.
Returns on capital run at 17% against a 9% cost of capital, a 8-point spread that creates value, though narrow enough that competitive pressure could close it.
The company is burning through $3M of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.
On the balance sheet, leverage is comfortably conservative at 0.0× net debt/EBITDA, and interest coverage runs at 3.6×.

Shareholder yield is only 0.0%, a thin return of capital, and stock-based comp at 12% of revenue is silent dilution an owner has to account for, and insiders hold 77% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is, and within its sector the business captures 49.1× its fair share of profits, a structural advantage visible in the numbers.
